text:
Fixed in a47dd03.
Root cause was broader than log breaks: a zoomed continuous/date/date-time axis kept only the whole domain's breaks that fell inside the window, so any deep zoom showed one tick or none (new RezoomSuite test: a linear zoom to 41.2..42.9 had zero x ticks before). Axes are now broken for the visible window (ContinuousScale.breaksWithin, TemporalAxisScale.axisTicksWithin); unzoomed axes and colorbars unchanged.
Breaks.log10: decade ticks when >=3 powers show (unchanged); otherwise the first sufficient rung of 1-3, 1-2-5, 1-2-3-5, 1-9; a sliver of one decade falls back to Breaks.pretty. Also fixed: inexact powers below one (9.999999999999999E-6 -> 1e-5) and a power emitted just outside the range at a log10 rounding boundary (found by the new sweep test).
Evidence at a47dd03: ScaleSuite exact values on JVM+JS; RezoomSuite log window ticks 5/10/20 and deep linear/date zoom >=3 ticks (both fail before the fix); CoordSuite zoom 20..40 now 20,25,30,35,40 with scale breaks unchanged. testAll 16 targets / 2,002 tests green; compatibility gate green (1 additive record: TemporalAxisScale$); links resolve; Playwright Chromium 151 from a clean a47dd03 worktree: navigation 15/15 (log zoom DOM ticks 5,10,20), widget 16/16, linked 11/11. CHANGELOG Changed entries, tutorial and date-time-and-zoom docs updated.
